form:FormGroup.label: Remember Notifications
form:FormGroup.helpText: Store the duplicate check column values of each notification in the duplicate check store so they can be viewed in the duplicates list.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stored values can be viewed in the duplicates list.

form:FormGroup.label: Suppress Duplicate Notifications
form:FormGroup.helpText: Do not send a notification if its values in the duplicate check columns match one already stored. Values are stored automatically while this is ticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Skips notifications that match a stored one.

form:FormGroup.label: Choose Columns
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: If unticked, grouped columns, or else all columns, are compared.

form:HelpHTML.p: If ticked, enter the column names in the Columns field to define which columns will be used for de-duplication of notifications. If unticked, the grouped columns are used, or all columns if the query has no grouping.
Note: Any change to the columns used for de-duplication will require the duplication store to be cleared.

form:FormGroup.label: Columns
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Comma-separated, case-sensitive. Enabled when Choose Columns is ticked.

form:HelpHTML.p: A comma delimited list of column names (case-sensitive) that should be used to de-duplicate notifications. Only editable when Choose Columns is ticked.
Note: Any change to the columns used for de-duplication will require the duplication store to be cleared.
